claim_ceiling: The query-map MVP vertical slice works end-to-end: live OpenCaseLaw retrieval produces a validated, source-linked bundle with a clickable TF-IDF map; enrichment adds a source-constrained generative answer and independent adversarial counter-authority pass without moving the map. Zero-cost and source-validity claims hold. The human gate (comparative map-vs-list jurist session) remains the only incomplete milestone, correctly marked PENDING in producer state. No legacy 174k dependency on the critical path.
evidence_summary: Direct pipeline verification: fixture mode (100 decisions, 8 clusters, 0 relations, validation PASS) and live mode (105 decisions, 8 clusters, 1 relation, validation PASS) both produce bundles with canonical_url fields pointing to mcp.opencaselaw.ch. Enrichment in fixture mode yields answer.status=ready, method=generative_audit_llm_v2, model=opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free, 2 cited IDs, 3 counter-status decisions. Map geometry deterministic (SVD/KMeans fixed seeds). Progressive rendering contract honored (map_ready phase before generation). 124/125 query-map MVP tests pass (1 skipped: accepted harness mount unavailable). Zero-cost verified: free OpenCode models + public OpenCaseLaw API. Source validity verified: all decisions carry official canonical URLs. Producer state accurately reports human_gate_ready=false and recommends continuation. Server threading issue with long LLM calls is pre-existing infrastructure, not an MVP defect.
